headline: 菲比布里吉絲新專輯獲讚
context: 美國創作歌手菲比・布里吉絲（Phoebe Bridgers）睽違六年推出第三張專輯，樂評普遍給出高分，她的同輩形容她是「這個世代的聲音」，泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）也是她的粉絲。同一週的口碑榜上，萊恩・墨菲（Ryan Murphy）與布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯（Bret Easton Ellis）合作的復古連環殺手劇集也名列其中。

sources.title: From The Shards to Phoebe Bridgers: the week in rave reviews

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The US songwriter’s third album has drawn rave reviews, she counts Taylor Swift as a fan and pop bears the imprint of her wit and pathos. Her peers explain how she did it This week, indie star Phoebe Bridgers releases her long-awaited third album, six years since her pandemic-era breakthrough. Alongside a slew of glittering reviews for Lost Weekend, including five stars from the Guardian , with it comes her first solo charting single in the UK – although the Californian musician’s influence runs far deeper than reviews or record sales could measure. Just how did a RuneScape-referencing, Halloween-costumed Berklee drop-out become the most influential songwriter of the 2020s? Bridgers’ idiosyncratic writing has shaped the sound of the decade. Her second album Punisher, released in June 2020 (and recorded many months before), spookily anticipated that strange, lonely year: in her eerie double-tracked vocals (a nod to Bridgers’ musical hero, Elliott Smith), Bridgers sang of empty shopping malls and conspiracy theories over lush, unsettling music made from watery electric guitar, Mellotron, strings, screams and birdsong. Today, Bridgers’ distinctive mix of dry wit and pathos is traceable in the lyrics of pop’s new chart toppers, such as Olivia Rodrigo and Gracie Abrams , while heavyweights across generations and genres, including Paul McCartney, Taylor Swift and SZA, have clamoured for collaborations. “She is the reference now,” Swift told the Guardian in 2022 . 菲比布里吉絲新專輯獲讚，被稱世代之聲

美國創作歌手菲比・布里吉絲睽違六年推出第三張專輯，樂評普遍給出高分，同輩音樂人形容她是「這個世代的聲音」，泰勒絲也是她的粉絲。同一週的口碑榜上，萊恩・墨菲與布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯合作的復古連環殺手劇集也名列其中。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
